method: Production dependency closure of the workspace packages/opencode in the bun.lock of the source commit: dependencies, optionalDependencies and peerDependencies that the lock resolves, workspace:* dependencies followed into the other workspace packages, devDependencies excluded. Names resolve the way Bun resolves them (nested override before the hoisted package). Licenses are read from the npm registry metadata of each exact version and written as one SPDX expression; the integrity is the hash from the lock.
caveat: This list is an upper bound, a superset of what Bun's bundler embedded in the executable: the set of modules inside the binary cannot be determined offline from the binary, so every package that the release could have bundled is listed and judged. Packages marked via=optional or via=peer are the least likely to be inside the binary. NONE means that the registry metadata declares no license; UNRESOLVED means that the license could not be read.
